mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE status IN (0, 1) AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM order_info WHERE status IN (1, 2)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') as dateStr, COUNT(*) as count FROM user WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY dateStr ASC

SELECT u.*, -- 统计发布了多少任务 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.publisher_id = u.id) AS publishedTaskCount, -- 统计接受了多少任务 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.taker_id = u.id) AS takenTaskCount, -- 统计发布了多少商品 (item 表 seller_id) (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item i WHERE i.seller_id = u.id) AS itemSoldCount, -- 统计买了多少东西 (order_info 表 buyer_id) (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_info o WHERE o.buyer_id = u.id) AS itemBoughtCount FROM user u
AND u.status = #{status}
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_log (operator_id, operator_name, type, content, create_time) VALUES (#{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{type}, #{content}, NOW())
